source_notes: Official competition URLs are the membership authority. Wikipedia season pages were used only to resolve club media pages.
Club crests are third-party trademarks and are not licensed for redistribution by this dataset.
Flags use lipis/flag-icons at an immutable Git commit under the MIT license.
UEFA competition pages are the authority for the 2026/27 League phase snapshot; qualifying-round clubs are excluded.
UEFA team IDs are the external deduplication key. Eight Spanish participants reuse their domestic identities and remain in their domestic primary groups.
UEFA crest images use the official UEFA image CDN; 240x240 is preferred and the pinned 70x70 URL is an explicit fallback.
